title: Public API invoice for a self-billed customer on Credit Hold is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a Public API key for the test organization, the Public API documentation, and a tool that sends API requests.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself, on the Credit Hold credit term.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, that bills itself.
custom_steps:
1. Send the Public API request that creates an invoice for work order 1.
  2. Send GET for work order 1 through the Public API.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The request is refused with an error response.
  • No invoice is created.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1, customer A's, is still Complete, with no invoice.
